checks.claim: EA Composite DTM 1m covers about 99% of England.
EA Composite DTM has 1 metre spatial resolution.
DTM is produced by removing surface objects from the DSM using algorithms and manual editing.
Composite DTM uses Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys.
Where repeat surveys exist, the newest best-resolution data is used.
Resampled composite source data uses bilinear interpolation.
2022 Composite DTM includes surveys from 6 June 2000 to 2 April 2022.
EA directs users to metadata index catalogues to identify the survey used at a location.
Composite DTM vertical accuracy is +/-15 cm RMSE.
Composite DTM exposes WMS service access.
Composite DTM exposes WCS service access for raster coverage.
